g.text: Two components were retained at both the nominal (n = 3,269) and the effective (n = 1,162) sample size; Kaiser's criterion would have retained three.
Parallel analysis has no survey-weighted implementation: it generates its null at the nominal n and therefore tends to over-retain, so it is used as a heuristic
supported by the scree plot and by whether a component is interpretable a priori.
